items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: A king, I used to have a king.

ctx.x: A king, I used to have a king.

King. Now tell me, when you used the E-flat, did you play a different part than the regular B-flat part? Octave high and any other instrument. Octave high, yeah. Did you just stick to the lead or did you play some fancy runs like the clarinet part?

That's right. You can do that too. Stick to the fancy too. Mm-hmm. Well, you best carry a straight lead. Carry a straight lead with it, you see. And that helps the rest of the band out. Sure. You used to have a variation in the band, the rest of the band. I don't know what the devil is all about.
